The datasheet for P-1-4 (Gorman-Rupp, water service, SG 1.0) gives no NPSH-required value — no NPSH parameter, table, or curve is included, so the required NPSH cannot be determined from the documents. What the datasheet does state: max operating pressure 250 psi (1723 kPa) up to 100 °F (37 °C), max casing pressure 266 psi (1834 kPa), max liquid temperature 160 °F (71 °C) per the seal limit, and performance curves only (VGH2 1/2C-B-1, 10.20" impeller, 1150–3450 RPM) with no single rated design point. gold.question: Regarding GV-12-3 on the P&ID: Does it need power? If so, what voltage, and will 24 V DC work, or do I need 230 V AC?

candidate: GV-12-3 is covered by the Georg Fischer Type 165 2/2-way solenoid valve datasheet, so it is an electrically actuated (solenoid) valve and does need power. Both 24 V DC and 230 V AC are offered variants of the valve, so 24 V DC will work if the 24 V DC version is installed; however, the documents do not state which voltage variant GV-12-3 specifically is, so whether you need 230 V AC or 24 V DC for this particular tag cannot be determined from the provided documents.
